# Aster Swap

> Aster Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping tokens on Aster, an on-chain exchange on BNB Chain that offers spot trading and perpetuals. Users connect their own wallet, review a quote and sign each transaction. The site never holds funds or keys.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Network: BNB Chain, where Aster runs as a non-custodial on-chain exchange.
- Products on Aster: spot trading and perpetual futures; this page focuses on swaps.
- Aster has its own token, ASTER.
- Gas token: BNB pays for approvals and swaps.
- Non-custodial: the user signs every swap and the interface never holds funds or keys.

## Pages

- Aster Swap & learn: https://swap-aster.github.io/
- Legal: https://swap-aster.github.io/legal.html
